mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_today_cache (region_code, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at) VALUES (#{regionCode}, #{temp}, #{sky}, #{pty}, #{wind}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE temp = VALUES(temp), sky = VALUES(sky), pty = VALUES(pty), wind = VALUES(wind), updated_at = NOW();
mapper.select: SELECT weather_id AS weatherId, region_code AS regionCode, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_today_cache WHERE region_code = #{regionCode} LIMIT 1
